description: This file defines the SliceFixture class used for integration testing in a .NET Core application, configuring an in-memory database and providing utility methods for scope execution, database operations, and request handling.

classes.name: SliceFixture
classes.description: Provides setup and utility methods for integration tests, managing service scope, in-memory database, and mediating requests.

methods.name: SliceFixture
methods.description: Constructor that configures services, in-memory database, and initializes the DI container.

methods.name: SendAsync (without request)
